facts: Rock star Ozzy Osborne saved his wife Sharon’s Pomeranian from a coyote by tackling and wresting the coyote until it released the dog.
A dog’s mouth exerts 150–200 pounds of pressure per square inch with some dogs exerting up to 450 pounds per square inch.
The Boy Scouts and Girl Scouts both offer merit badges in dog care.
A dog's nose is made up of about 220 million scent receptors, while a human's nose has about 5 million.
A dog's sense of smell is so powerful that they can detect changes in a person's emotional state.
